prayerExcerpt.en-US: Grant that the people consecrated to you may always receive new growth in faith and holiness.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Concedei que o povo a vós consagrado cresça constantemente na fé e na santidade.

meta.face: A spare, tireless Castilian of about sixty-two, clean-shaven, with a LONG face BROAD AT THE JAW — a high, bald, domed crown with a short fringe of grey hair above the ears, a long, large, straight nose, pale grey-blue eyes under heavy lids and high-arched grey brows, lean cheeks with deep lines from nose to mouth, a small, tight-lipped, resolute mouth and a broad, firm chin; skin weathered and browned by years on the roads of the Andes; a grave, kindly gaze down toward the child.
meta.basis: The seventeenth-century portrait (Wikipedia lead), which I checked, shows him clean-shaven and bald with a grey fringe, a long, large nose, heavy-lidded pale eyes and arched brows, in a red cappa with Andean people behind him. The card follows it, weathered by his journeys on foot through the diocese, and shows him confirming, as he confirmed nearly half a million people.
